verdict.rationale: Inngest documents an official CLI for inspecting runs, fetching traces, invoking functions and giving coding agents access to Inngest data from the terminal. A dedicated guide covers debugging failed runs entirely through the CLI, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's agent-oriented workflows, and detailed evidence of the full command surface (e.g. auth, output formats for agents).
